A1.justification: Both PDFs contain complete, readable versions of the same VideoShield work, including Appendices A–G. Text, equations, tables and figures support reliable comparison despite changes in placement.

before.justification: v1 reports original watermark extraction, tamper localization, robustness and computational experiments, plus a 24-participant video-quality study in Appendix E.1.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experiments and the Appendix E.1 user study, with numerical outcomes in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: Section 2 retains the same template-bit construction, Gaussian-noise embedding, DDIM inversion, temporal matching and HSTR/PTB spatial localization. The localized wording edits do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same VBench-derived prompts, real conditional images and Stable-Diffusion-Prompts data. Video/image tasks, temporal manipulations, spatial tampering and distortion scenarios remain unchanged, including appendix evaluations.

E2.justification: RivaGAN, MBRS, CIN, PIMoG, SepMark, MVSS-Net, OSN, PSCC-Net and HiFi-Net retain their corresponding comparisons. EditGuard already appears in v1 Appendix E.6/Table 15 and remains unchanged. Newly cited works are not added experimental baselines.

E3.justification: Section 3.1 and Appendices D–F retain sample counts, generation settings, watermark payloads, thresholds, metrics and testing procedures. The user-study, robustness, resolution and computational-overhead protocols also match.

E4.justification: Both contain the same PTB and hierarchical-level ablations, inference/inversion sensitivity tests, distortion studies, inversion-accuracy and resolution analyses, and SVD failure cases. None of these analyses is added or removed.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including comparison-accuracy distributions and quantile ranges in Figures 4, 9 and 11 and Table 18. There are no additions or revisions to run counts, seed information, confidence intervals or significance testing.

E6.justification: Tables 1–19, plotted results and qualitative examples retain the same findings. For example, Table 1 reports VideoShield bit accuracy of 1.000 for ModelScope and 0.999 for SVD in both versions; Table 15 retains localization scores of 0.906 and 0.761.

T1.justification: Equations 1–13 are unchanged, including the Gaussian-distribution derivation and temporal/spatial localization definitions. No formal assumptions, mathematical arguments or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free watermarking during generation, joint extraction and spatiotemporal localization, preserved video quality, and applicability across video and image generation models.

C2.justification: The explanations of HSTR's accuracy–granularity tradeoff, distortion robustness and SVD failure conditions remain unchanged in Section 3 and Appendices E–G. The new Appendix A.2 scope note concerns related-work framing rather than a revised limitation of VideoShield.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, data-processing instructions, hardware and runtime disclosures, and the code/models link are unchanged. The dataset URL in Appendix D.4 is merely renumbered from footnote 1 to footnote 2.

R1.justification: v2 adds SuperMark and six references concerning data or model watermarking. Appendix A.2 explicitly limits its taxonomy to AIGC and identifies those other applications as outside scope. The substantive positioning against Gaussian Shading and tamper-localization methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds acknowledgments and a short scope footnote, makes localized wording edits, and updates author/affiliation formatting and bibliographic details, including Robust-Wide's publication information. The scientific narrative and section organization are retained.

P2.justification: The same 19 tables and 24 figures remain, with placement and spacing changes. Table 1 moves from page 8 to 7, Figure 2 from page 5 to 4, and Figure 5 from page 9 to 8. The author block is reformatted; figure content and table structures are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Appendix A.2 improves precision by changing an unrestricted watermarking taxonomy into one explicitly about AIGC and distinguishing related data/model watermarking applications with supporting references. This is a limited improvement in research framing; the methods, empirical evidence, reproducibility information and limitations remain unchanged.
